findings.problem: City IDs are checked in country-keyed pending/failure sets, and the first rejected directory promise is cached forever.
findings.fix: Map city to fact.countryId for state; clear only the identical failed initialization promise so explicit retry can create a new request.

findings.problem: Country preparation has no latest-actor guard or visible pending/error/retry state; failures are unhandled or swallowed and unprepared display metadata falls back to ISO placeholders.
findings.fix: Use a monotonic actor token, retain ready UI while loading, publish only the latest result, and present recoverable pending/offline/error states without placeholder authority.

findings.problem: startup-size validates selected index/shard presence but totals only JavaScript chunks; download-budget's full Brotli measurement does include them.
findings.fix: Add selected OutputAsset raw/gzip bytes to separately labelled full startup totals.

findings.problem: A literal 50 aborts a 55-row combined tree before measurement, while simply removing it could admit unreviewed rows.
findings.fix: Derive and compare the exact ordered trusted admission IDs; keep queued/closed rows outside admission or update projections and pins explicitly.

accepted: Runtime directory validates exact country set and exact per-country city rows before publication.
Trusted local facts retain admission, routing, name, coordinate, and airport authority; HTTP metadata supplies no fares or links.
Default server/Node provider remains eager and synchronous; Vite swaps only browser imports.
No source path automatically fetches every country shard.
